summary: Tested iter-4 features (Export Halaman Aktif, POS quickadd, POS Cash/Transfer metode_bayar) end-to-end on PHP simbeng_v1. Added /app/backend/tests/test_export_and_pos_metode.py with 8 pytest cases: (1) export scope=page&per_page=25 returns exactly 26 <tr>, filename hints 'daftar_sparepart_hlm1_', subtitle shows 'Halaman 1' and 'N baris (dari <total>)'. (2) export scope=all returns total+1 <tr> (verified against the total scraped from the page-scope subtitle). (3) scope=page with q=OLI shows 'Pencarian: "OLI"' subtitle and every row matches. (4) scope=page with filter=low shows 'Stok Menipis' subtitle and every row is MENIPIS. (5) DB schema check via php CLI confirms transactions.metode_bayar column exists with default 'cash'. (6) POST save_trx with metode_bayar=transfer redirects to receipt, DB persists 'transfer', receipt shows Cash=☐ (☐) + Transfer=☑ (☒). (7) Same with cash default; receipt shows Cash=☑ + Transfer=☐. (8) Cleanup of TEST_ transactions. All 8 pass. Ran regression suite (test_simbeng_php.py + test_parts_pagination.py) — 21/21 pass. Frontend Playwright: login → parts page: all 8 export testids present (parts-export-page-group + parts-export-all-group with pdf/xls/doc each); parts-export-page-xls href correctly builds 'export.php?type=parts&scope=page&p=1&per_page=25&format=xls'; clicking it downloads xls with exactly 26 <tr>. POS page: pos-quickadd-input/btn/scan-btn/msg/suggest, pos-metode-bayar-group with cash checked by default all present; typing 'OLI-001' + Enter adds a part-row and shows 'Ditambahkan: OLI-001 - Oli Mesin 10W-40 800ml'; typing 'OLI-001' again does NOT add a new row and increments qty to 2; typing 'ZZZ-999' shows 'Sparepart dengan kode/barcode ... tidak ditemukan'; typing 'OLI' shows 2 pos-quickadd-suggest-item, clicking first adds row; selecting Transfer radio (label click) checks metodeTransfer; pos-quickadd-scan-btn opens #scanModal (regression).
critical_code_review_comments: export.php line 44: uses direct string interpolation for LIMIT/OFFSET ($per_page, $offset). Values are int-cast + in_array whitelisted so safe, but binding as ints would be consistent with parts.php pattern.

pos.php has grown to 441 lines with heavy inline JS (quickadd + scanner). Consider extracting POS JS to assets/js/pos.js for maintainability. Same recommendation as prior iteration for parts.php (now 670 lines) still stands.
receipt.php line 108: strtolower($t['metode_bayar'] ?? 'cash') safely falls back when column is NULL; migration ensures column always exists after any authenticated page load — good defensive coding.

pos.php findPart() (line 325) does startsWith prefix fallback which could unexpectedly match partial kodes on Enter — currently mitigated by exact-match priority; consider suppressing fallback for Enter-key path if strict scan behavior is desired.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test transactions during POS tests (jasa nama prefixed TEST_cash / TEST_transfer). Cleaned up in the same test file via php CLI to keep DB tidy. 610 parts seed preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export xls responses are HTML tables served with vnd.ms-excel MIME + BOM; assertions on <tr> counts are stable. transactions.metode_bayar column is added on first authenticated page load by init_db (informationschema migration). Use customer_id=1 (Anas) and parts kode OLI-001 (id=1) for POS smoke tests. Preview URL: https://simbeng-stock-search.preview.emergentagent.com/
